tei:div.tei:p: (387)༄༅/"$ /dpal bde mchog sdom 'byung nas kyi chang gi cho ga bzhugs so/// /

(388)༄༅// rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thungs pas rnam par dag pa'i thugs// gnas la sogs pa yul du bgrod pas rnam par dag pa'i sku// dpal gyi gnas kyi dbus mchog dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po dang*// bla ma mchog la spyi bos btud de rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang*// bde chen ye shes sgrub pa'i phyir// dpal ldan sdom pa 'byung ba las// gsungs pa'i chang gi cho ga bri// de la 'dir rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi sgor zhugs nas lam nyams su lan pa'i rtsa ba ni dam tshig yin la/ de la yang dam tshig ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs dbang bskur ba dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dam tshig gi tshogs bskyang ba gnyis las/ dang po dbang bskur ba yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel la/ de'i skabs su chang dgos pa dang*/ dam tshig gi tshogs bskyang pa la (389)yang rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis// dam tshig bzhir bsdus pa'i ya gyal bza' ba'i dam tshig la rgyun dang*/ khyad par gyi gnyis las/ phyi ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo la bzhad cing*/ de de bzhin du don 'di rgya bod kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa ches che ba rnams zhal gyi bzhes pas/ dam tshig gi tshogs bskyang ba'i skabs su dgos shing*/ der ma zad rdzogs rim gyis lus dub na/ zungs bskyed pa'i bcud len gyi mchog tu yang chang bstan pa yin no/ chang de yang chang ma rnams kyi lhag par yang gtsang sbra dang bral ba'i myos byed bag med du 'dod pa bsten pa la/ 'khyol nyog tu spyod pa'i blun po rnams kyi longs spyod dang*/ lus zungs dang*/ dge ba nyams dma' bar byed pa ni/ sngags kyi tshul 'dod pa rnams kyis khyi'i skyugs pa ltar spang bya yin la/ de'i bshad pa rgya cher mkhan po chos kyi rje pas mdzad pa'i spring yig slob ma la phan pa las khong du chud par bya'o// (390)der cho ga bzhin du btsos pa'i chang zhes gsungs pa'i don/

bde mchog sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel bzhin bshad par bya ba la lnga/ chang bsten dgos pa'i 'thad pa/ 'thad ldan gyi chang sgrub pa'i cho ga /sgrubs pa'i chang ji ltar 'thung ba'i tshul/ cho ga dang mi ldan pas btung ba'i nyes dmigs/ ji lta ba bzhin bsten pa'i phan yon no// dang po rgyud gzhan nas gsungs pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ re shig rgyud 'di nyid nas/ sbrang chang bur chang khu ba'i chang*// de bzhin ji ltar rnyed pa dbul/ zhes le'u brgyad pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lha mchod pa'i skabs nas 'byung la/ de nyid kyi glu gar gyis bdag nyid tshim par bya ba'i skabs nas kyang*/ chang gi ston mo dga' bcas pas/ zhes gsungs shing*/ le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i skabs nas/ 'dir ni brtson ldan rdo rje lha mo rnams// chang dang sha rnams kyis kyang rab mchod bya/ zhes dang*/ bza' dang myos byed btung ba dang*/ zhes gsungs/ nyer bzhi pa bcud len gyi le'u las/ myos byed gtor ma mnyam ldan pas// lha rnams la ni mchod par bya/ zhes dang*/ so gnyis pa gtor ma'i le'u las/ myos byed gtor ma med pa las// myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ de'i phyi nas lhag ma'i gtor ma bsdus la dam tshig sgrub par bya ste/ kha myos byed kyi bkang nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bsgom par bya'o/ zhes dang*/ le'u nyer lnga pa myos byed nges par brtan pa 'di nyid las/ tshad med ye shes gang las skye// rnam shes kyang ni gang las 'gyur// ye shes rnam shes phun sum tshogs/ chang gis 'gro ba (391)kun tu rmongs// zhes dang*/ mchod pa chang gi btung ba med// mar dang bral ba'i sbyin bsreg dang*// bla ma dam pa med pa'i chos// chos dang bral ba'i mi rigs nyid// gzhan du srid min chang med na// dam tshig gang du 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gnas dang zhing dang tshan rdo ha// 'dus pa dang ni dur khrod dang*// mchod bya mchod byed 'brel pa la// bdud rtsi'i mchod yon mchog yin te// rgyud dang rgyud gzhan gsungs pa yi// bkra shis bde ba la spro'o// pha mes lha dang mi rnams dang*// bag ma blang dang mchod sbyin las// bram ze'i mchod sbyin las rnams dang*// rgyal rigs rnams kyi g.yul ngo dang*// rje rigs rnams kyi bkra shis don// dmangs rigs dngos grub sgrub pa'i dang*// rab byung mchod pa'i dus rnams dang*// yun ring rnam bshad spyod yul dang*// rab gnas sbyin bsreg dus rnams dang*/

gnas rnams bskor ba'i spyod yul dang*// spyan drangs rnal 'byor ma mchod dang*// sngags sgrub de yi dus rnams su// de ltar rnam mang shes bya ste// de yi nyes pa brtag mi bya// lhag par byed par bshad par bya// gsang ba sa yi bdag po nyon/ zhes cho ga bzhin btsos pa'i chang dgos pa mtha' yas pa dang ldan par gsungs so// gnyis pa chang sgrub pa'i cho ga la gsum/ chang gi dbye ba mdor bstan/ skyu ru ra'i chang sogs drug gi cho ga rgyas par bshad// yul dus kyi chang btso ba'i cho ga /'bru'i chang la sbyar te lag tu blang ba'i rim pa bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rdzas skyes de bzhin zhes pa nas// chang gi ming du rab tu brjod// zhes pa'i (392)bar rkang pa bcus bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ shi gru'i sman ni zho gnyis dang*/ zhes pa nas/ yul gyi rjes 'gror 'gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis/ skyu ru ra'i chang dang*/ dha ti ka'i chang dang*/ pa tra ka'i chang dang*/ kha ra'i chang dang*/ shi gru la sogs pa'i chang dang*/ shau bhañdza na la sogs pa'i chang ngo*/ de dag gi cho ga yang*/ drod kyis smin par byed pa'i gos dang*/ rdzas sogs snod dang*/ dha ti krī ni me tog dmar po 'char ba'i shing chang la nges par mkho ba dri bzang zhim po yod pa/ 'di bo ril nag po yin nam/ shau bhañdza naḥni shaṃ gru ste na le she dkar po'o/ klu ma rnams klur bskyed pa dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing mchod pa/ lhar bskyed pa rnams 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga sbyar ba nyid yin no// gsum pa ni/ sna tshogs chang gi cho ga dag /shes nas yul gyi rjes 'gror 'gyur/ zhes pa'i 'grel pa las/ yul gyi rjes 'gro zhes pas chang yul gyi rjes su 'gro ba/ zhes par bya'o// yul ni nye bar mtshon pa ste/ dus kyi yang ste/ drod chung ba'i yul dang*/ dus su nyin gcig la tshar ba'i chang mi bya'o/ zhes dgongs pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ yul bong 'di lta bu na/

rgyu nas gro sogs las btsos pa/ dus zhag gnyis gsum gyi smin pa yod pas/ de'i cho ga ni/ rgyud 'di'i sgor zhugs nas dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sngags pa/ khyim pa yin na shes rab dbang thob pa dang bcas pa'am/ rab tu byung ba yin no/ dbang thob pa'i bu mo la bsngags pa'i sgo nas sam/ ma 'byor na rang nyid kyi chang sgrub la/ de'i tshul yang chang btso mkhan skyes pa yin na 'khor lo bde mchog /bud med kyis byed na rdo rje phag mo'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyun du ma chag par nyams (393)su len pa'i thun 'tshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dang po nyid du chang 'tshod pa'i rdza ma gtsang mar byas/ nas gro sogs chang gi rgyu'i 'bru rnams kyang byi dor byas la gu gul gyis bdug /me tog gis mchod la/ de nas chu dang lhan cig pa thab la bkal te/ yi dam gyis sngags zlos shing me btang*/ thab chu chod nas/ 'grems ran pa dang*/ re lde sogs gtsang mar dgram/ srog chags med pa'i sngos smin par byas pa'i phabs ji ltar 'tshams pa btab/ der chang bsnyol ba'i rdza ma yang gtsang bar byas/ gu gul gyis bdug /me tog gis mchod nas/ chang gi lam rtswa'i chun po'am/ gos sogs gtsang zhing grod che ba sta gon byas pa la/ mtha' yas dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/ chu lha ste/ stod mi la smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka dang ldan pa bdag la mngon du phyogs pa rang 'dra ba'i mdzes mas phyogs g.yon nas 'khyud pa rnam par bsams la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wa ru ṇa yang hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.a nan ta ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥb su ki hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dkar pos yang dag par mchod nas/ lag pa g.yon pa gdengs ka'i tshul bstan cing g.yas pa brkyangs nas/ oṃ wa ru ṇa/ a nan ta/ ba su ki /oṃ bhak+ṣa a gats+tsha a gats+tsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhur bhur wa pheṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod de/ 'o ma'i gtor ma byin nas sngar bzhin mchod de/

yo mal klu gsum gyi rang bzhin du bsam pa la rdza ma bzhag /der sbang ma rnams bcug nas/ rdza ma'i nang du skad cig la bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha bcu gsum gyis dkyil 'khor bskyed/ 'khor dang (394)bcas pa zhu nas maṃ yig dmar ser du gyur/ de las chang gi lha mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bcwo brgyad ma/ lang tsho la bab pa nyi ma'i 'od lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i bcud bzang po sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na/ ral gri/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ thod pa/ rdo rje/ rgyal mtshan/ mu tig gi phreng ba/ dril bu/ mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon pa rnams na/ phub/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ril ba/ spyi blugs/ mdung*/ tho ba/ pi waṃ/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing 'jig rten gsum po dbang du bsdud pa'i sku can du bsgom/ de bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi khu ba'i gzugs nyid kyis gnas bar lhag par mos shing*/ ji srid ma khugs kyi bar du gos la sogs pas bsro zhing bkur sti bya'o// de nas smin pa dang srog chags med pa'i chu bsrings te lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal/ sngags zlos sogs la brtson pas bsring bskor bya ba ni cho ga'o// de ltar cho ga bzhin bcos pa las/ chang ro zhim pa/ kha ba dang*/ dngar ba sogs 'byung ngo*// de dag kyang*/ rgyud las/ mtha' yas nor rgyas chu lha dang*// der ni gdan du bsgom bya ste// me tog gu gul bdug pa dang*/ gtor ma gtor ma'i tshogs rdul tshon gshegs gsol kyi klu'i gtor sbyar byin nas brtsams par bya/ zhes dang*/ man+dā ra las byung ba kun// chu bor gyur te dbus 'gro ba/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ mar dang sbrang rtsi lta bur 'bab// zla ba'i btung ba bu mo ste// rdo rje rnam snang*/ mdzad skur gnas// rnam par snang mdzad sku dbus su// he ru (395)ka yi zhu bar 'gyur// dpa' bo kun dang mnyam sbyor ba// mchog bde mkha' 'gro ma dra ba// thams cad gcig tu gyur pa yin// bdud rtsi drag po'i gzugs can ma// 'phog par byed pa longs spyod de// snying po bdud rtsi de bzhin no// zhes dang*/

de ru skyes pa'i tshang lha mo// bu mo 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma// nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog mtshungs shing*// rgya skyegs khu ba lta bu'i mdangs// rin chen kun gyis spras pa'i lus// pad+ma'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od// yi ge ma las byung ba'i sku// mdzes shing phyag ni bco brgyad de// sna tshogs bcud 'dzin lha mo ni// 'jig rten gsum po dbang sdud ma// g.yas na ral gri mda' lcags kyu// thod pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*// de bzhin mu tig phreng dril bu// dgu pas mchog ni rab ster ba'o// g.yon pa'i phyag na phub dang gzhu// zhags pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ril ba spyi blugs dag dang mdung*// thod pa pi waṃ bgrang phreng ste// gzhon zhing long tsho phun sum tshogs// lha mo mdzes ma spyan gsum can/ zhes dang*/ cho ga yang dag rdzogs byed na// myos byed mchog ni skye bar 'gyur// gang tshe grub pa'i chang sems pa// nyi ma nyi ma dag tu bya// sbyong ba 'di ni mchog tu mdzes// grub pa'i myos byed yid dga' ba/ zhes dang*/ rno dang kha dang tsha ba dang*// mngar dang 'jam pa skye bar 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ bdag nyid bsod nams dbang la lar// bla ma mnyes pas rnyed par 'gyur/ zhes thor bur gsungs pa rnams kyi don/ 'grel pa pad+ma can las/ de'i phyir dam tshig yongs su bskyang ba dang*// bla ma mnyes par byed pa ni// myos byed do zhes ston pa ni// (396)bdag nyid ces pa la sogs pa/ la la zhes pa rnal 'byor pas dam tshig yongs su bskyang ba'i bsod nams dang*/ bla ma mnyes pa las kyang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don 'thob par 'gyur te/ de yang dam tshig gi rdzas dang bral bas ma yin no// zhes gdon mi za bar dam tshig gi rdzas btso bar bya'o// de la 'di ni btso ba'i cho ga ste/ yul dang*/ dus dang*/ nus pa ji lta ba bzhin ji ltar gsungs pa'i sman rnams nye bar bzhag nas shes rab dang bcas pa'i sngags pas/

gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i mdun du/ mtha' yas dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/ chu lha ste klu'i bdag po gsum gyi rang bzhin/ phyun po la sogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rdza ma gu gul gyi dud pas bdug te/ me tog gis mchod la/ de'i nang du sho bhañdza na las sogs pa gnur ba'i gong bu chu dang bsres pa bcug nas rdza ma'i nang du dpal rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa'i dpal bde mchog 'khor dang bcas pa bde ba chen por zhu bar gyur pa las/ skyes pa'i maṃ yig las byung ba'i chang gi lha mo ji ltar gsungs pa'i rang bzhin can rnam par bsgoms te/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi khu ba'i gzugs kyi gnas pa lhag par mos shing bsro ba la sogs pa rgyun du bya'o// zhes pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ji ltar 'thung ba'i tshul ni// bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod pa ste/ de yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs dang 'brel na rang rang gi skabs bzhin bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ las kyi rdo rjes drang ba dang*/ blangs te myang ba'i tshul rnams/ mkhan po chos kyi rje (397)nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga las rtogs par bya'o// rgyud 'di rtsa 'grel las 'byung ba'i byin rlabs dang longs spyod tshul 'di/ tshogs kyi 'khor lor ma zad// dam tshig can gyi sngags pas dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe/ chang bsten pa'i dus thams cad du byu ba yin no// de'i tshul yang*/ rgyud las/ lhag par byed pa bshad par bya// gsang ba sa yi bdag po nyon// bla ma dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// mchod cing rjes su spyad par bya/ zhes pas yul gang la mchod pa bstan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sngags kyis so// zhes pas mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing mchod pa bstan/ gang gis mchod na byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis/ tshul ji ltar byin gyis brlab na/

rkang pa gcig po mar yang sbyar la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sngags kyis so// rtag tu byin gyis brlab bya zhing*// ha ha hrīḥzhes pa sngags so// sbyang ba dang ni rtogs par bya// ha yis kha dog 'phrog par byed// ho yis dri ni 'phrog par byed// hrīḥyis nus pa bcom pa dang*// bdud rtsi'i rnam pa'ang bstan par bya/ de ltar byin rlabs med par 'thung ba la nyes pa ci yod na/ lha gsum la sogs dang bral bas/ gal te sred ldan 'thungs gyur na// de ni dug 'gyur the tshom med// sngags kyi dngos grub skye mi 'gyur/ byin gyis brlabs pa yang mi myos tsam 'thung ba yin te/ ha cang myos na su zhig chang gi myos gyur pa// de la bgegs ni mang po 'byung*// zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i 'grel par/ kun spyod kyi cho ga nye bar ston pa gsungs ba/ lhag par zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ lhag par byed pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i btung ba'i don du'o// (398)bla ma dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma zhes pa/ bla ma dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams so// 'di ltar gsungs te/ lag pa g.yas par ho yig las skyes pa'i 'khor lo rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin/ ho yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam par bsgoms te/ de'i steng du ha yig las skyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ha yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin rnam par bsgoms pa'i lag pa g.yon pas bkab cing*/ rdzas kyi steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin bltas nas lan gsum dang lnga dang bdun du ha ho hrīḥzhes pa'i sngags brjod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags rdzas kyi steng du rim pas g.yas dang*/ g.yon dang*/ mdun du gnas pa/ de kho na ltar brjod cing*/ mnyes par byed pa'i cho gas/ bla ma dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes par bya ste/ rang nyid kyang bsten par bya'o// de ltar ma byas par bstan pa'i nyes pa gsungs pa/

lha gsum zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid oṃ la sogs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ lag gnyis pad+ma'i bskor ba byas nas chang gi snod thod pa'am/ med na snod gang yin thod par bsam pa blangs te lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ g.yon pas steng nas bkab ste/ byin gyis brlab tshul gzhung nyid kyis shes so// de nas rtsa rgyud las/ zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na/ rtag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar 'thung zhing*/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bya'o// cho ga de ltar byas nas thams cad la sbyin nam zhe na/ bla ma (399)la 'khu bla ma smod// sems can 'khu la sbyin mi bya// bdud rtsi dang ni dug de nyid// dngos grub sgrub pa 'bras bu med// 'di dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis// sngags pa'i spang bar bya ba gsungs/ dam tshig dang ldan pa la ni bslu bar mi bya ste mi sbyin par mi bya ba yin te/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma 'dus la// cho gar gsungs bzhin bslu mi bya// dngos po thams cad thun mong la// skal dang skal min brtag mi bya// des na 'dus pa rab tu gsungs// dngos grub rjes su snang ba thob// zhes gsungs so// rang lus kyi bdud rtsi lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa bzhin du/ phyi rol du cho ga bzhin btsos shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang yang*/ rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can yin te// thab khung chos kyi 'byung gnas grags// glu ma ni bdud rtsi dag tu bsgrags// chang gang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gang zhig drod de he ru ka// pad+ma gar dbang de mdog nyid// gang zhig dri de rin chen 'byung*// ro gang de ni don yod grub// gang zhig rlung gi shugs bdag nyid/ zhes so// 'dir mdor bsdus tsam zhig gsungs la/ cho ga dang dbye ba rgyas par rgyud gzhan du shes par bya ste/ chang gi dbye ba 'di dag ni// rgyud dang rgyud gzhan shes par bya/

zhes so/ bzhi pa cho ga dang mi ldan pas 'thungs pa'i nyes dmigs ni// sngags pa chang gis rnam 'gyur zhing*// 'dod pa la brkam 'khrig par sred// gar byed de bzhin rgod pa (400)dang*// 'thab mo la spro rnam par 'phrul// smod cing nyams par byed pas kyang*// dmyal ba ngu 'bod du 'tshed 'gyur// rnal 'byor ma kun khros pa dang*// sdig pas dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur zhing*// de la nad dang mya ngan 'jigs// rnam 'tshe 'jigs su rung ba 'byung*// zhes so// lnga pa ji lta ba bzhin bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ shes rab blo dang stobs dang bde// skal bzang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs// dbang phyug yon tan brgyad po kun// thob 'gyur bla med 'bras bu yi// zhes gsungs pas/ dang por chang gi rgyu ngo bo gtsang ba/ sdig pa las grub pa ma yin pa rnams tshogs par byas/ cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du btsos/ smin par byas nas/ sngags pa dam tshig can gyis cho ga bzhin byin gyis brlabs te lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod na/ tshe 'dir shes rab dang*/ blo dang*/ stobs 'phel ba dang*/ phyi ma bde 'gror skyes nas/ skal ba bzang po 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor par 'gyur ba dang*/ skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du dbang phyug gis yon tan brgyan dang ldan pa'i dpal he ru ka'i sku mngon du byad par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// gsang ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa yi// sgor zhugs rnal 'byor rnams kyi bsten bya'i chang*// rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshogs bsgrub po zhes// bla mas gsung pa'i bzhed pa bdag gis bkod// nongs gyur bla ma lhar bcas bzod mdzad nas// dge bas 'gro kun rgyud sde rgya mtsho rnams// bla ma'i man ngag (401)gis bsrubs bdud rtsi'i mchog /rim gnyis zas la rtag tu rol par shog /ces pa 'di ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung las skyes pa'i bu chung dag tu gyur pa rig pa 'dzin pa kun dga' blo gros la tsha ba rong pa'i dge bshes rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas dpal gyis yang dang yang du bskul nas/
dpal e waṃ chos ldan yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su bgyis pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//
